mapper.sql: r.id, r.room_type, r.name, r.house_id, h.title AS house_title, h.image AS house_image, op.userprofile_id AS other_profile_id, ou.id AS other_user_id, ou.username AS other_username, other.avatar AS other_avatar, COALESCE(os.is_online, FALSE) AS other_online, lm.id AS last_message_id, lm.content AS last_content, lm.message_type AS last_message_type, lu.username AS last_sender_name, lm.created_at AS last_message_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message unread WHERE unread.room_id = r.id AND unread.is_read = FALSE AND unread.is_deleted = FALSE AND unread.sender_id != #{profileId}) AS unread_count, r.created_at, r.updated_at

JOIN chat_room_participants selfp ON selfp.chatroom_id = r.id AND selfp.userprofile_id = #{profileId} LEFT JOIN chat_room_participants op ON op.chatroom_id = r.id AND op.userprofile_id != #{profileId} LEFT JOIN user_profile other ON other.id = op.userprofile_id LEFT JOIN auth_user ou ON ou.id = other.user_id LEFT JOIN online_status os ON os.user_id = other.id LEFT JOIN house h ON h.id = r.house_id LEFT JOIN chat_message lm ON lm.id = ( SELECT MAX(lastm.id) FROM chat_message lastm WHERE lastm.room_id = r.id AND lastm.is_deleted = FALSE) LEFT JOIN user_profile lp ON lp.id = lm.sender_id LEFT JOIN auth_user lu ON lu.id = lp.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chat_room r WHERE r.id = #{roomId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room (room_type, name, house_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{roomType}, #{name}, #{houseId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room SET updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{roomId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room_participants WHERE chatroom_id = #{roomId} AND userprofile_id = #{profileId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT m.id, m.room_id, m.sender_id, u.id AS sender_user_id, u.username AS sender_name, p.avatar AS sender_avatar, m.message_type, m.content, m.is_read AS `read`, m.created_at FROM chat_message m JOIN user_profile p ON p.id = m.sender_id JOIN auth_user u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE m.room_id = #{roomId} AND m.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.id, m.room_id, m.sender_id, u.id AS sender_user_id, u.username AS sender_name, p.avatar AS sender_avatar, m.message_type, m.content, m.is_read AS `read`, m.created_at FROM chat_message m JOIN user_profile p ON p.id = m.sender_id JOIN auth_user u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE m.room_id = #{roomId} AND m.is_deleted = FALSE AND m.id IN #{id} ORDER BY m.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (room_id, sender_id, message_type, content, is_read, is_deleted, is_recalled, recall_reason, recalled_at, created_at) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{messageType}, #{content}, #{read}, #{deleted}, #{recalled}, #{recallReason}, #{recalledAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message m JOIN chat_room_participants p ON p.chatroom_id = m.room_id WHERE p.userprofile_id = #{profileId} AND m.sender_id != #{profileId} AND m.is_read = FALSE AND m.is_deleted = FALSE
SELECT id FROM online_status WHERE user_id = #{profileId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO online_status (user_id, is_online, last_seen) VALUES (#{profileId}, #{online}, #{lastSeen})
mapper.update: UPDATE online_status SET is_online = #{online}, last_seen = #{lastSeen} WHERE id = #{id}
